title: Token Clock — Your AI Bill Now Depends on What Day You Run It
tagline: DeepSeek made API tokens peak-priced on 16 Aug 2026, then exempted the whole weekend on 23 Aug. Output tokens run up to 1,100% above the old flat rate inside two weekday UTC windows, and Saturday and Sunday are now off-peak all day. Map your traffic onto the bands in your timezone, price a full week, and see what moving batch work to the weekend is worth. 100% in your browser, no API key.
description: Price a full week of LLM traffic against DeepSeek's weekday peak bands and weekend exemption, in your timezone.
